hook.text: A shopping app sends a sale notification. The user taps it, and nothing happens. The link is broken.

buildup.text: Push notifications involve delivery, display, tap action, and behavior when the app is open, closed, or killed.

discovery.text: Testing covers all app states: foreground, background, and terminated—each handles notifications differently.

twist.text: Silent notifications update content without alerting the user. Testing them requires checking data, not UI.

climax.text: Notification tests in all three app states reveal the tap action fails when the app was killed. Bug fixed.

punchline.text: Test notifications in every app state. Not just the easy one.

quiz.question: In how many app states should push notifications be tested?
options: Only when the app is open
Only when the app is closed
